03 — Site Layout

Second Dwelling & 3-Car Carport

Main House

3-Car Carport

Custom steel-frame, Colorbond® Monument skillion roof. Concrete slab with engineering certification. Positioned between 2nd dwelling and main house.

2nd Dwelling — Granny Flat

New 1-bed, 1-bath, ~60m² detached. Matching design: render, Monument roof, black aluminium windows, hardwood deck.

Pool Retained & Upgraded

Existing pool retained and landscaped. Pool fence and paving upgraded to complement new aesthetic.

Driveway Extension

Shared concrete driveway extended to serve carport and granny flat. Decorative saw-cut finish.

Landscaping

New garden beds, native plantings, turf re-establishment and irrigation around all structures.

4. WindowsBlack powder-coated aluminium double-glazed frames. ~18 units upper level.$38,000$60,000$2,000–$3,500 per large-format unit installed.

06 — Due Diligence

Assumptions & Sources

Assumptions
  • All costs are 2025 AUD estimates inclusive of GST
  • Property assumed NSW, non-coastal (no BAL/Colorbond Ultra uplift)
  • Existing roof area estimated at ~260m² from aerial photos
  • Upper wall brick area ~220m²; lower level ~120m²
  • ~18 large-format windows across upper level — final count may vary
  • Garage conversion assumes ~30m² usable lower-level space
  • New granny flat assumes flat, accessible ground — no major earthworks
  • 3-car carport assumes 9m × 6m on existing cleared lawn
  • Driveway extension ~150m² at mid-range finish
  • Council DA/CDC fees will vary — check with your local LGA
  • Labour rates based on NSW regional market (5–10% below Sydney)
  • Does not include interior main house renovation, solar or panel upgrades
  • Allow 3–5% cost escalation per year of delayed commencement
  • Always obtain minimum 3 fixed-price quotes from licensed builders
